primitives.name: Air Density Correction
primitives.verbatim_quote: AIR: venue air density 1.1179 kg/m3 measured at Arrowhead Stadium [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/weather-pilot/weather-stadium-pilot.json] -> ball carries measurably differently than a sea-level-standard model assumes ; wind 12.7 km/h qualifies it -> deep-ball and kick distances shift; totals and long-DK props carry the effect, spreads barely 2.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\rho_{\\text{air}}': 'Air density in kilograms per cubic meter'}
primitives.assumptions: Standard atmospheric model adjusted for local conditions; wind velocity impacts trajectory via drag coefficient.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( \rho_{\text{air}} \neq 1.225 \, \text{kg/m}^3 \), ballistic trajectories deviate from sea-level reference.

layer2.mapping: Maps environmental air density to modified projectile kinematics for distance estimation in kicking and passing plays.

primitives.name: Injury Availability Shift
primitives.verbatim_quote: AVAILABILITY: Josh Simmons (KC) listed QUESTIONABLE [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/injuries/espn_nfl_injuries_week6.json] -> unit rotation depth changes at that position -> snap share and pressure/scheme leverage shift toward the opponent's strength 3.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\Delta S': 'Change in snap share (dimensionless)', 'I_{\\text{questionable}}': 'Injury status indicator (binary)', 'P_{\\text{position}}': 'Player position category'}
primitives.assumptions: Injury status correlates linearly with positional substitution impact; scheme leverage is quantifiable via play design.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( I_{\text{questionable}} = 1 \), \( \Delta S \) becomes non-zero and affects strategic allocation.

layer2.mapping: Maps injury severity to expected change in offensive or defensive scheme effectiveness using historical substitution matrices.
layer2.telemetry: Expected change in play success rate due to substitution

primitives.name: Tracking Efficiency Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: Dobbins (LAC) records RYOE = -47.7 [docs/data-sources/research/2026-10-13/ngs/raw_statboard_rushing.json] -> live tracking proves in-season trench/separation mechanics (not historical proxy) -> provides immediate ground-truth efficiency adjustment for weekly player projections and game game-scripts 8.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\text{RYOE}': 'Rushing Yards Over Expected (yards)', 'd_i': 'Actual rushing distance (yards)', 'd_{\\text{expected}}': 'Expected rushing distance (yards)', 'w_i': 'Weight factor for each play'}
primitives.assumptions: Each play contributes independently to cumulative efficiency; weights reflect contextual importance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Negative values indicate underperformance relative to baseline expectations.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies deviation from expected performance using real-time tracking data to inform projection adjustments.
